tasks.title: Compose E2E proves console settings and resend across live services
tasks.spec: ## Repository: deploy, all Files, Behavior, Checks and Completion evidence; Rollout order; Decisions 4, 10-14; Security impact (CI/secrets); Acceptance evidence 8. Keep the test-only overlay, counting/switchable webhook receiver, parsing-fixture test, scenario and CI wiring in ONE integrated task. Reuse common bun-tools, read-only token/secret mounts, no token output or setup-default/image-pin changes. Scenario creates sole-scope tokens in 0700 temp directory, recreates status/notify/e2e-hook once with overlay, Owner sign-in, console name/showLatency live within 30 s without further restart, reference-only DB webhook/new incident, receiver 500 then 200/one Resend -> exactly 1 extra same-key request, showChecks env-lock text, sentinel output scan, restore services/cleanup even after failure. Full prints exact published-images skip; dev probes /admin/notify/channels then feature skip or runs. Explicit CI lint step bash e2e/runtime-settings.test.sh and e2e-dev grep -qx 'ok: runtime settings'. Docs console-first/token/files/env override/recreate once; full/dev showChecks lock. All lint-job checks and full/dev Compose E2Es plus PR security/evidence belong here.

acceptance.expected: exit 0; fixed fixture answers exercise parsing helpers, exact hook-count delta 1 with unchanged idempotency-key, feature/skip branches; docker compose config --quiet succeeds for runtime overlay with both full and dev bases. Receiver switches 500/200 and counts by idempotency-key.

acceptance.command: git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 shellcheck -x && git ls-files -z '*.sh' | xargs -0 -n 1 bash -n && git ls-files -z '*.mjs' | xargs -0 -n 1 node --check && git ls-files -z '*.json' | xargs -0 -n 1 jq empty
acceptance.expected: exit 0 from repository root with all new files tracked; all tracked shell/receiver/JSON files pass the lint-job syntax checks, including the new e2e files outside Biome's cli-only scope.
exit 0; lint, typecheck and the full suite pass with at least 80% line coverage.

exit 0 with all four merged feature services built from main; exact line 'ok: runtime settings', name/showLatency live within 30 s with 0 restarts after overlay setup, 1 new-incident hit and exactly 1 extra same-idempotency-key resend hit; field text 'Set by PULSE_STATUS_SHOW_CHECKS'; 0 token values in step output; later persistence steps pass after restoration.
exit 0 on published images; exact line 'skip: runtime settings (published images)' and remaining full-stack scenarios stay green.

acceptance.command: bash e2e/outage-history.test.sh && bash e2e/metric-is.test.sh && bash e2e/manual-count.test.sh && bash e2e/published-port.test.sh && bash e2e/console-setup.test.sh && bash e2e/snippet.test.sh && bash e2e/dev-console-prefills.test.sh && scripts/check-setup.sh && bash scripts/check-setup.test.sh && bash scripts/secrets-init.test.sh && bash scripts/bump-images.test.sh && bash scripts/wait-ready.test.sh && bash scripts/init-secrets.test.sh
acceptance.expected: exit 0; every existing helper/static/secrets test of the touched CI lint job passes alongside the new runtime-settings.test.sh acceptance. CI explicitly invokes that new test and e2e-dev requires the literal 'ok: runtime settings' line.

PR includes bun run check output and CI lint/e2e-dev logs proving the explicit helper test and 'ok: runtime settings', full skip evidence and applicable Security impact checklist. Confirm read-only token/secret mounts, temp-dir mode 0700, 0 token values in output, no new action/permission or changed setup defaults/image pins, cleanup/restoration, and documented console-first operator override rollout.
